delegates.description: Ordered read-only execution delegates; first definite match wins. Off unless configured.

command.description: Executable and fixed arguments; gh argv is appended unchanged. No shell. Relative executable paths resolve against the config directory.

match.description: Must explicitly select effect: read and level: L1 (native) or L2 (REST). L2 also requires method: GET.

command.description: gh command path prefixes such as "pr merge" or "api".

env.description: Invocation environment: names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; all entries must match. Values use path.Match globs; * means set and non-empty (including /); an empty value means unset or empty. Caller-controlled guardrail, not a security boundary.

exitCode.description: Post hooks only: gh exit codes (0-255) to run for.

level.description: L1 native gh command, L2 gh api REST call, L3 gh api graphql call.

method.description: HTTP method on the same normalized REST operation, e.g. GET. Does not match native commands or GraphQL.

operation.description: Action globs such as pr.merge.* (see docs/normalization.md).

parameters.description: Normalized operation parameters (see docs/normalization.md), e.g. {watch: "true"}; all entries must match on the same operation. Values use path.Match globs over the scalar's text; * means present and non-empty; an empty value means absent or empty.

result.description: Post hooks only: success = gh exited 0; failure = non-zero exit, killed by a signal, or gh could not be started.

token.description: Kind of token in GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN: app (ghs_, GitHub App installation, e.g. gain or Actions), user (ghp_/gho_/ghu_/github_pat_), unknown (other value), none (not set: gh's stored login).

onError.description: Start failure or timeout before output: fallback (default) to real gh, or deny with exit 78. Never retry after output or a signal.
